caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair positioned centrally within a square border on a cream background. The chair has a curved backrest, two curved rockers at its base, straight legs, spindles, and two armrests. The wood is rendered in shades of brown and tan, with the backrest slat and the connecting segment under the seat colored in a lighter, reddish-brown tone. The backrest slat features a decoration of green and brown leaves. Surrounding the chair are three botanical elements: to the upper left and upper right are clusters of brown and green leaves, while to the left of the chair, there is a vertical row of small, elongated green leaves with a circular dot at the top. The composition is arranged so that the rocking chair is the main feature, with the botanical drawings distributed around it without overlapping the chair.
title: Rocking Chair
